limitations: This is single-writer exclusive-owner hierarchy replacement, not concurrent multi-writer, published-reader MVCC, or concurrent migration.

Candidate construct allocates a source hierarchy for the known growth level. Abseil starts empty and grows naturally. The trace includes candidate construct/prepare/finish/release and Abseil automatic rehash, but does not hold capacity policy equal.
Phase-summed lifetime excludes read timing, correctness oracle, footprint census, shared Orbital pool setup/drain; it sums separate clocks, not one uninterrupted lifetime clock.
Each arm gets one complete untimed history warmup. Nine repetitions cyclically rotate arm order. Positions are rotated but predecessor effects are not balanced.

Multimap initial build already differs between arms before scan grain is used. This is a negative control against attributing lifecycle differences to scan budget. Allocator/history carryover is plausible but not isolated.
Scan budget charges source traversal work only. Destination collision-chain search, allocation and retirement are not bounded by this work counter; no wall-clock latency bound follows.

Independent hits visit all 2*n entries in deterministic insertion order after a full read warmup. Serial value/caller cycles visit the original n entries only, after total size doubles. Serial cost includes caller dependency work.

Abseil ordinary and exact-key owners are uninstrumented during timing. Untimed requested memory includes Abseil internal arrays plus multimap vector capacities; physical backing is unknown (CSV zero is a sentinel).

Candidate requested, physical owned_capacity and metadata are separate inventories. Metadata must be included in a total logical cost. Coexistence census observes both candidate indexes. Baseline samples omit transient rehash peaks; no peak-RSS advantage can be claimed.
Candidate physical capacities vary with shared-pool allocation history even for identical logical geometry. Per-arm median backing is not a storage-format/grain advantage.

Nine repetitions within one process/host are descriptive, not independent machine trials or confidence intervals. Cache residence was not established from these footprints; this is not a DRAM/Loom prefetch study.

ISA/microarchitecture are confounded across hosts: Zen5 AVX2 x86-64-v3, Granite native AVX-512, V2 NEON. Fixed current geometry is used on all three; this does not select platform-optimal layouts or isolate AVX-512 benefit.
